releasedLocalDamage.visualFinding: The release clears or overwrites enough hilt and rear-leg material to destroy believable hand-to-hilt continuity and depth ordering even though every changed pixel remains formally authorized.

connectivityAndAnchors.anatomicalFinding: Connectivity is mechanical only. The return width grows toward the wrist and its median is 59.38% of its 234.094px length, producing a club or third-leg mass rather than an arm.

actualWedge.recomputedRule: closed triangle AND min(R,G,B) >= 220 AND channel spread <= 26 AND not independently derived foreground AND not r24 grip disk

fullFrame.finding: The construction reads as an enormous armored third leg or shield attached near the shoulder. The V is fused into one solid mass; the restored hand appears through a circular punch-out; the elbow becomes an oversized mechanical disk with a conspicuous white crescent halo; and the upper attachment ends as a hard stump. It visibly overwrites the hilt and rear thigh and breaks depth ordering.

gameplayScale.finding: Surface detail disappears but every structural defect survives: the extra-leg silhouette dominates, the hand aperture becomes an ambiguous dot, and neither elbow articulation nor a readable arm-return wedge remains.

exactRound018Prescription.oneConstraintChange: Move only elbow anchor E from (370,845) to (484,894), offset (+114,+49), while keeping shoulder S=(604,472), original grip G=(450,625), and the exact 24px grip restore fixed.
exactRound018Prescription.whyThisExactChange: It is the unique smallest integer elbow move preserving S and G that permits one uninterrupted 5,526px theoretical wedge with conservative anatomical lower-bound widths of 70px upper and 64px return; the exhaustive search tested 48,405 configurations. The absolute smaller grip move is inadmissible because it breaks the original hand/grip requirement.
exactRound018Prescription.freeze: Freeze identity, face, hair, torso, weapon, lighting, framing, original hand/grip pixels, S, G, and every pixel outside the recomputed local triangle-dilated-62 editable mask; retain the exact r24 grip restore.
exactRound018Prescription.requiredRebuild: Discard the Round017 transplanted limb and rebuild the two-segment arm from geometry at S->E'->G with widths no thinner than 70/64px, one anatomical elbow, no socket disk or halo, no hilt/rear-leg overwrite beyond the recomputed authorized mask, and an independently measured uninterrupted pale component of at least 5,525px.
exactRound018Prescription.requiredGameDelivery: Integrate the resulting Nyra Kestrel Round018 target as an actual game asset under a Round018/Nyra capture contract and submit a fresh Unity frame whose manifest names that target; a Round001 Astra or a 2D proof cannot satisfy this step.
